target_year_over_year_context.explanation:

The 2024 disclosure (D043) covers the 'Application Networking and Security Software Portfolio' which includes zero-trust lateral security and Advanced Threat Prevention to combat malware and ransomware. While the specific product name changed from 'Symantec endpoint security' to the broader 'Application Networking and Security' portfolio with 'Lateral Security Firewall', both address cybersecurity threat prevention and detection across infrastructure.

The 2023 disclosure (D047) covers Network Security solutions to stop inbound/outbound threats. The 2024 disclosure (D043) covers Application Networking and Security software, which includes zero-trust lateral security and Advanced Threat Prevention. Both disclosures address network/application level security threats and protection against malware/ransomware.

comparisons.peer_summary: AMD Solarflare offers low-latency networking solutions using hardware adapters and Onload libraries, serving as the preferred solution for capital markets high-performance applications.
comparisons.comparison: Both AVGO and AMD disclose specific networking product portfolios within Item 1, though they target different market segments and underlying technologies. AVGO’s Application Networking and Security Software focuses on zero-trust lateral security, load balancing, and malware/ransomware defense through software-defined solutions. In contrast, AMD’s Solarflare portfolio emphasizes low-latency hardware networking adapters and user-space libraries, specifically targeting high-performance capital markets applications. While both provide networking capabilities, AVGO is centered on security and load balancing software, whereas AMD provides low-latency hardware/software hybrid solutions for trading ecosystems.

sentences.text: Our application networking and security software delivers zero-trust lateral security and load balancing solutions enabling global digital organizations to combat malware and ransomware.

• Lateral Security Firewall: This solution enables access control for applications, protects against lateral movement of threats and provides security policy recommendations based on the workloads, and enables isolation of sensitive applications for enhanced regulatory compliance.
The AMD Solarflare™ portfolio offers a comprehensive low latency networking solution that combines hardware adapters with the Onload™ family of user space networking libraries.
AMD Solarflare products are the preferred networking solution for capital markets, enabling customers to develop a wide range of high-performance applications across the entire trading ecosystem.
